card.title: Back Me Up
card.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have no conflicting memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain?

mechanism: A seeks B's support for a disputed shift agreement and downgrades the request to credible-looking silence when words are refused.
confusable: Unlike solo excuse-making, A must maneuver another person into supporting the account.
comparison: D31-b recruits appearance of agreement; D31-a recruits memory of a just-created bin conversation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
